title: 当更多变成更少：语言模型中位置依赖的重复效应
summary: 该研究通过双探针设计发现，语言模型对重复目标词的预测依赖于读取位置：相邻重复符合直觉，而移位重复呈倒U型曲线。在13个模型中验证，并排除长度、冗余等混淆因素，表明重复计数探针不能忽略读取位置的影响。
summary_en: This study shows that language models' predictions for repeated target tokens depend on readout position: adjacent repetition follows intuition, while displaced repetition shows an inverted-U curve. Validated across 13 models and 42 multilingual cells, with causal ablations ruling out confounds.
